name: Mr. Smite's Brass Compass
source_text: Mr. Smite's Brass Compass Release the memories of a long-lost first mate. Drop: Yorik Sharpeye Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Kang's Bindstone
source_text: Kang's Bindstone Become infused with stone, granting a chance upon killing an opponent to encase them in stone. "Mogu stonebinders use these rune-etched catalysts to transform flesh to stone." Drop: Kang the Soul Thief Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Chalice of Secrets
source_text: Chalice of Secrets Give in to your anger for 10 seconds. While active, the next killing blow made against a player will transform you into a Mogu for 5.5 seconds, preventing any actions from being taken while you gloat. "The rituals for desecrating a fallen opponent are a well-established part of Mogu culture." Drop: Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Farwater Conch
source_text: Farwater Conch Allows you to see far into the distance and grants the ability to create small water droplets. "Inscribed with Jinyu runes that allow the user to understand the language of the waves." Drop: Zai the Outcast Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Panflute of Pandaria
source_text: Panflute of Pandaria Play the panflute, causing nearby critters to follow you for 15 minutes. Drop: Moldo One-Eye Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Pandaren Firework Launcher
source_text: Pandaren Firework Launcher Set up a dazzling firework display. "Party over here!" Drop: Ahone the Wanderer Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Ai'Li's Skymirror
source_text: Ai'Li's Skymirror Take on the slightly shimmery appearance of the target for 10 minutes. "Rimmed with an ever-shifting ring of clouds." Drop: Ai'Li Skymirror Dread Wastes --

name: Hozen Beach Ball
source_text: Hozen Beach Ball Get ready for fun in the sun! Drop: Ik-Ik the Nimble Dread Wastes --

name: Nat's Fishing Chair
source_text: Nat's Fishing Chair Set up a comfy fishing chair. "It even has a beverage holder!" Achievement: Learning from the Best (Fishing) -- --

name: Gin-Ji Knife Set
source_text: Gin-Ji Knife Set Chop, mince, and julienne a fresh humanoid or beast corpse. Vendor: Gina Mudclaw Valley of the Four Winds Faction: The Tillers – Exalted 250 Gold

name: Shado-Pan Geyser Gun
source_text: Shado-Pan Geyser Gun Unload a torrent of water on allies and enemies with the Geyser Gun. Achievement: Tortos Hidden Geyser Achievement Throne of Thunder Must obtain 250 stacks of Spray Water from the geyser before Tortos.

name: Gastropod Shell
source_text: Gastropod Shell Summon and control Jerry the Snail. Drop: Gastropod Throne of Thunder --

name: Celestial Defender's Medallion
source_text: Celestial Defender's Medallion Take on the guise of a Celestial Defender. Vendor: Mistweaver Ku Timeless Isle Faction: Emperor Shaohao – Revered

name: Odd Polished Stone
source_text: Odd Polished Stone Become infused with stone, granting a chance upon killing an opponent to encase them in stone. "A stone from a time long past, polished to a shine from eons of erosion." Drop: Eroded Cliffdweller Timeless Isle --

name: Blackflame Daggers
source_text: Blackflame Daggers Wear the Blackflame Daggers, signifying your allegiance to Ordos. "Ceremonial daggers used by champions of Ordos. Drop: Champion of the Black Flame Timeless Isle --

name: Eternal Kiln
source_text: Eternal Kiln Places an Eternal Kiln that increases the spirits of those nearby by 4 and allows cooking. "Followers of Ordos carry small cauldrons of fire with them for long journeys into the wilderness." Drop: Eternal Kilnmaster Timeless Isle --

name: Warning Sign
source_text: Warning Sign Place a Warning Sign that lasts for 1 minute. A message can be carved into the sign, causing it to last for 1 hour and making it visible to other players. Drop: Jakur of Ordon Timeless Isle --

name: Rime of the Time Lost Mariner
source_text: Rime of the Time Lost Mariner Sing the haunting melody of the crew lost on the Dread Ship Vazuvius. Drop: Dread Ship Vazuvius Timeless Isle --

name: B.F.F. Necklace
source_text: B.F.F. Necklace Offer the necklace. Drop: Huggalon the Heart Watcher Townlong Steppes --

name: Cloud Ring
source_text: Cloud Ring Summon a cloud ring that your pet will jump through. Requires a flying pet. "Fun for your flying pet." Vendor: San Redscale The Jade Forest Faction: Order of the Cloud Serpent – Revered 1,000 Gold

name: Cremating Torch
source_text: Cremating Torch Cremate the body of a fallen ally. Quest: Choking the Skies Townlong Steppes --

name: Flippable Table
source_text: Flippable Table Unleash your rage by flipping a table forward. Vendor: Nam Ironpaw Valley of the Four Winds 3 Gold 59 Silver

name: Foxicopter Controller
source_text: Foxicopter Controller Summon a remote controlled Foxicopter to fly around for 45 seconds. Vendor: Sally Fizzlefury Valley of the Four Winds 1,000 Gold

name: Glorious Standard of the Kirin Tor Offensive
source_text: Glorious Standard of the Kirin Tor Offensive Plant your Kirin Tor Offensive banner. Quest: Securing A Future Isle of Thunder --

name: Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught
source_text: Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught Plant your Sunreaver Onslaught banner. Quest: Life Blood Isle of Thunder --

name: Gokk' lok's Shell
source_text: Gokk' lok's Shell Stand on a piece of Gokk' lok's shell. Moving cancels the effect. Quest: Promises of Gold Dread Wastes --

name: Hozen Idol
source_text: Hozen Idol Focus your gaze intently on the target critter, causing it to explode from the pressure after several seconds. Quest: A Monkey Idol Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Jin Warmkeg's Brew
source_text: Jin Warmkeg's Brew Summon Jin Warmkeg's Brew, which allies can use to have a drink of his ale. Quest: Holed Up Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Ken-Ken's Mask
source_text: Ken-Ken's Mask Put Ken-Ken's Mask on a friendly target. Quest: Zhu's Despair Krasarang Wilds --

name: Lao Chin's Last Mug
source_text: Lao Chin's Last Mug A strong alcoholic beverage. Quest: Do a Barrel Roll! Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Pandaren Scarecrow
source_text: Pandaren Scarecrow Plant your Pandaren Scarecrow. "It certainly looks scary to me." Vendor: Gina Mudclaw Valley of the Four Winds Faction: The Tillers – Revered 250 Gold

name: Puntable Marmot
source_text: Puntable Marmot Summons a Puntable Marmot at target location. Quest: Rampaging Rodents Valley of the Four Winds --

name: Sen'jin Spirit Drum
source_text: Sen'jin Spirit Drum Summon a set of three spirit drums that anyone can play. Vendor: Ravika Echo Isles 10 Gold

name: Shushen's Spittoon
source_text: Shushen's Spittoon Summons Shushen's Spittoon on the ground at target location for 1 minute. Allies can click on the Spittoon to use it. Quest: Raid Leader Slovan Krasarang Wilds --

name: Silversage Incense
source_text: Silversage Incense Summon a burning stick of Silversage Incense at target location for 20 seconds. Quest: Roadside Assistance Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Stackable Stag
source_text: Stackable Stag Summon a Stackable Stag at the target location. If there is another Stackable Stag nearby, your Stackable Stag will stack on top of it. Vendor: Sally Fizzlefury Valley of the Four Winds 1,000 Gold

name: The Golden Banana
source_text: The Golden Banana Throw the Golden Banana. "Solid gold, and obscenely heavy." Quest: Buried Hozen Treasure Krasarang Wilds --

name: Totem of Harmony
source_text: Totem of Harmony Summon a Totem of Harmony at the target location, illuminating the area for 1 minute. Quest: Hatred Becomes Us Townlong Steppes --

name: Turnip Paint "Gun"
source_text: Turnip Paint "Gun" Throw a ball of orange paint at your current friendly target, turning them orange for 6 seconds. Quest: Yellow and Red make Orange Valley of the Four Winds --

name: Ruthers' Harness
source_text: Ruthers' Harness Summon Ruthers, the bad yak. Quest: Pick a Yak Townlong Steppes --

name: Shard of Archstone
source_text: Shard of Archstone Transform into a Mogu Statue, becoming untargetable for 5 minutes. "A fragment of unknown origin, seething with ancient power." Drop: Havak Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Battle Horn
source_text: Battle Horn Blast a blaring horn, attracting enemies within 40 yards. Ineffective on targets above level 100 or not native to Pandaria. "Carried by Yaungol scouts to alert allies to impending attacks." Drop: Blackhoof/Ordon Candlekeeper Valley of the Four Winds/Timeless Isle --

name: Essence of the Breeze
source_text: Essence of the Breeze Unleash a gentle breeze, lightening your steps. This effect only works in Pandaria. Drop: Ai-Ran the Shifting Cloud Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Aqua Jewel
source_text: Aqua Jewel Increases swim speed by 50% and allows underwater breathing for 10 minutes. Only usable on Pandaria. Drop: Sahn Tidehunter Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Cursed Swabby Helmet
source_text: Cursed Swabby Helmet Transform into a Cursed Hozen Swabby, able to breathe underwater and swim 200% faster. "Used to transform lowly swabbies into mindless hozen brutes, able to row the dread ship Vasuviuz." Treasure: Sunken Treasure Timeless Isle --

name: Salyin Battle Banner
source_text: Salyin Battle Banner Blend into the shadows for 1 second and summon a Salyin Warscout. The Warscout will draw the attention of nearby monsters and run into the distance. Only effective in Pandaria. "Stained with the blood of many unlucky adventurers." Drop: Salyin Warscout Valley of the Four Winds --

name: Bottled Tornado
source_text: Bottled Tornado Jump high into the sky on the winds of Pandaria. Can only be used outdoors. "The Mantid learned long ago how to bend the winds of Pandaria to the Empress' will." Drop: Kal' tik the Blight Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Eternal Warrior's Sigil
source_text: Eternal Warrior's Sigil "Restores 15% of health and mana every 1 second for 6 seconds. Any damage taken will remove the frenzy. Can only be used in Pandaria. "Granted to Shek'zeer's elite guard for service to the Empress." Drop: Gar' lok Dread Wastes --

name: Helpful Wikky's Whistle
source_text: Helpful Wikky's Whistle Calls Helpful Wikky, who will forage for you and bring back presents. Can only be used in Pandaria. "Appears to have been heavily chewed on." Drop: Major Nanners Vale of Eternal Blossoms --

name: Turnip Punching Bag
source_text: Turnip Punching Bag Summon a Turnip Punching Bag at target location for 5 minutes. The punching bag acts as a target dummy while it persists. Only usable outdoors "A turnip with an extremely tough exterior, it can take hits just as well as a heroic level dungeon boss." Quest: Leaders Among Breeders Valley of the Four Winds --

name: Anatomical Dummy
source_text: Anatomical Dummy Summon an Anatomical Dummy at target location for 5 minutes. The punching bag acts as a target dummy while it persists. Only usable outdoors in Pandaria. "Artifact details have already been logged in your Archaeology Journal, under the Completed Artifacts tab." Archaeology -- Mogu Archaeology Fragments

name: Censer of Eternal Agony
source_text: Censer of Eternal Agony Sacrifice 90% of maximum health to become an Emissary of Ordos. While transformed, you are hostile to all players, and killing players grants Bloody Coins. Can only be used on the Timeless Isle and flags the user for PvP. "Ritualistic sacrifice is a requirement to enter the ranks of the Ordon." Vendor: Speaker Gulan Timeless Isle 1,000 Timeless Coins

name: Hardened Shell
source_text: Hardened Shell Throw a hard shell, dismounting the target. Unusable on target above level 94. "Seems unfair." Drop: Nessos the Oracle Kun-Lai Summit --

name: Ash-Covered Horn
source_text: Ash-Covered Horn Summons a ridable but uncontrollable Furious Ashhide Mushan. This is a very, VERY fast mount. Can only be used on the Timeless Isle. "Perpetually warm to the touch." Drop: High Priest of Ordos Timeless Isle --

name: Anglers Fishing Raft
source_text: Anglers Fishing Raft You can raft across water. "Great for fishing but takes on water…so don't stay out too long!" Profession: Fishing Krasarang Wilds Faction: The Anglers- Revered and 525 Fishing

name: Kirin Tor Beacon
source_text: Kirin Tor Beacon Returns you to the Kirin Tor on the Isle of Thunder. This beacon only works on the Isle of Thunder or in the Throne of Thunder. Alliance Only Quest: The Storm Gathers Townlong Steppes --

name: Sunreaver Beacon
source_text: Sunreaver Beacon Returns you to the Sunreavers on the Isle of Thunder. This beacon only works on the Isle of Thunder or in the Throne of Thunder. Horde Only Quest: The Storm Gathers Townlong Steppes --

name: Portable Yak Wash
source_text: Portable Yak Wash Perform an emergency yak wash in the field. Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 500 Timewarped Badges

name: Adopted Puppy Crate
source_text: Adopted Puppy Crate Release your adopted puppies for 10 minutes of fun. "All they needed was someone to play with them." Vendor: Mistweaver Xia Timeless Isle 1,000 Timewalking Badges
